entries.name: YM2203 OPN
entries.description: Yamaha FM chip with three four-operator channels, two timers and a built-in three-voice SSG, programmed through an address port and a data port.
entries.behaviour: The first port selects a register and the second writes it: 0x00 to 0x0F reach the SSG and 0x10 up the FM. Reading the first returns status (bit 0 timer A flag, bit 1 timer B flag, bit 7 busy); reading the second returns an SSG register, and 0 at an FM address.

handlers.read: register read: offset 0 status, offset 1 data
handlers.write: register write: offset 0 register select, offset 1 data

entries.name: YM2608 OPNA
entries.description: Yamaha FM chip with six four-operator channels, a built-in SSG, six ADPCM-A voices and one ADPCM-B channel, in two register banks.
entries.behaviour: Four ports: the first pair selects and writes bank 0 (0x00 to 0x0F SSG, 0x10 to 0x1F ADPCM-A, 0x29 interrupt mask, the rest FM), the second pair bank 1 (0x100 to 0x10F ADPCM-B, 0x110 flag control, the rest FM). Reads: offset 0 status, 1 SSG register (address 0xFF gives 1), 2 extended status, 3 ADPCM-B register.

handlers.read: register read: offset 0 status, 1 data, 2 extended status, 3 ADPCM-B data
handlers.status_hi_r: extended status, with the ADPCM-B flags
handlers.write: register write: offset 0 select, 1 data, 2 second bank select, 3 second bank data

entries.name: YM2610 OPNB
entries.description: Yamaha FM chip with an SSG, six ADPCM-A voices and one ADPCM-B channel reading sample memory, in two register banks; the YM2610B is the same chip with more FM channels.
entries.behaviour: Four ports as on the YM2608. Bank 0: 0x00 to 0x0D SSG, 0x10 to 0x1B ADPCM-B, 0x1C end-of-sample flag reset, the rest FM; bank 1: 0x100 to 0x12F ADPCM-A, the rest FM. Reads: offset 0 status, 1 SSG register (0xFF gives 1; 0x0E and 0x0F give 0xFF), 2 end-of-sample flags, 3 always 0.

handlers.read: register read: offset 0 status, 1 data, 2 end-of-sample flags, 3 data
handlers.write: register write: offset 0 select, 1 data, 2 second bank select, 3 second bank data

entries.name: YM2612 OPN2
entries.description: Yamaha FM chip with six four-operator channels, two timers and a 9-bit DAC that replaces channel 5, in two register banks.
entries.behaviour: Four ports: offsets 0 and 1 select and write a register of the first bank, offsets 2 and 3 of the second (0x100 up); a data write after the other bank's address is ignored. Offset 0 reads the status (bit 0 timer A flag, bit 1 timer B flag, bit 7 busy); the other offsets read 0.

handlers.read: status read: offset 0 status, the other offsets 0
handlers.write: register write: offset 0 select, 1 data, 2 second bank select, 3 second bank data
